dialogue.speaker: Brother Tallow
dialogue.text: [He writes for a long time.] 'I took my vow of silence so I would never have to confess something.'

dialogue.speaker: Brother Tallow
dialogue.text: [Another slate.] 'The abbey's donation box was never as full as it should have been. I was the reason.'

dialogue.speaker: Brother Tallow
dialogue.text: [He looks at you.] 'I have told no one this. I find I do not mind that it is you.'
